summary: Bundle bndl-1cfb993962c1ffb6 (Northside Clinic, 2026-11-10 06:05-15:05Z). Supported: on workstation, console session by account sdubois (workstation#34, tty1) ran a patients_full clinic-export that wrote a 19.8MB file to /tmp/.font-unix/upd-4c2e.pkg at about 11:22:38Z (shell history, fs_stat, records export_bulk log, tap inbound flow from records). At 11:25:43-11:25:56Z the workstation sent 19,832,008 bytes to 10.20.9.12:8080 via curl PUT, an unapproved destination above the 5MB policy threshold. Not supported as an incident: the single absent auth.log line at 11:20:32Z (downgraded; a line-level gap with write or copy fault not excluded), and the records access.log gap before 08:55Z, which is routine rotation with off-host archive (benign).
